integrity: Reproducible finite checks and an explicit all-dimension mathematical proof; mathematical independence is not claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only ideal best-rank spectral preconditioners, exact two Frobenius pilot norms, Gaussian quadratic forms and the two specified allocation choices. No failure or competitive guarantee for the implemented randomized Nyström/leave-one-out decision is claimed. Best-rank oracle cost is idealized; 3-step Lanczos itself is exact on the examples. Historical priority not exhaustively certified.
title: Two-pilot oracle indistinguishability and unbounded MSE loss in log-determinant budgeting
